doc: 外層做法 E1–E6（04_prereg_map.md §2）。參數照 X6（docs/phase3_20261017/explore/X6_real_systems.md §4.1，permalink 代號 [V*]/[L*]/[S*]/[M*]/[D*]/[A*] 見 X6 附錄）。'used' 是模擬器真的讀的欄位；'x6' 是查到的系統預設，'not_modeled' 是有查到但模擬器沒做的機制（寫在 06_simulator.md §2）。

E1.name: CPU only, LRU evict -> drop (miss = recompute)

x6.evict_when: only when space is needed, ref_cnt==0 [V4]
x6.store_threshold: single tier only, default store all [V3][V8]

not_modeled: touch order is reversed in vLLM (tail blocks of a request are evicted first) [V2]; the session engine evicts whole sessions (X1 semantics)

E2.name: CPU + SSD, CPU full -> demote LRU session to SSD (case b)
E2.represents: LMCache (per 04 §2); in X6 the closest default is Mooncake offload_on_evict, LMCache in-process default is write-through (H0) -> see E3
not_modeled: SSD tier capacity / SSD eviction (unlimited, as X1)
watermark eviction (Mooncake 90%/5%, LMCache MP 0.8/0.2) [M1][L6]: evict-as-needed instead

E3.name: write-through: every block written to CPU is also written to SSD
E3.represents: SGLang HiCache write_through (default) [S1]; also vLLM 0.28 tiering 'Always offload to all tiers' [V6] and LMCache in-process store (H0)
not_modeled: L2->L3 backup happens after L1->L2 completes (H0); here the SSD write is issued at round end together with the CPU write

E4.name: write to SSD only after a block has been used the 2nd time
E4.represents: SGLang write_through_selective (hit 2 times) [S1]; Dynamo KVBM presence_lfu (min_lfu_count=8) [D1]; AIBrix HOT (first hit in L1) [A1]

E5.name: E2 + demote to SSD when idle > T (case a)
E5.represents: Mooncake soft pin (default 30 min, reads do not extend it) [M1]
not_modeled: Mooncake semantics are 'soft-pinned objects are evicted last'; 04 §2 defines E5 as 'idle > T -> move to SSD', which is what is simulated (plus E2's capacity LRU when CPU is full before T)

E6.name: E2 + start reading SSD blocks as soon as a request enters the queue
E6.represents: SGLang HiCache L3->host prefetch on entering the waiting queue [S5]; LMCache async lookup prefetch [L1][L9]

used.serve: fifo1 (one GPU, FIFO; X4) — in serve=trace there is no queue and E6 == E2

x6.timeout_code_default: 1 s + 0.25 s per 1K tokens, threshold 256 tokens [S6]
x6.timeout_doc: 2 s + 0.1 s per 1K tokens, cap 30 s [S9] (doc and code disagree; X6 used code)

not_modeled: prefetch timeout: the request does not proceed before its prefetch completes; Cake restore waits on in-flight blocks (X4 QP semantics, 'wait_complete'-like)
